h1: Pick, pack and track, hands free and in real time.
lede: SmartPick is an AR smart glasses solution for picking and packing with real-time backend updates. RFID-enabled automated tracking gives warehouses live inventory visibility, fewer errors and faster throughput, without a scanner in hand.

blocks.text: AR-powered solutions designed to improve efficiency across industries

SmartPick is one of four solutions on the Smart Solutions Platform from Purview Technologies, the group’s AI and XR company. The platform puts AR smart glasses, real-time captioning and translation, and Purview’s vision and voice AI into the hands of frontline teams, so the people doing the work see what they need, hands free, and the people supporting them can be anywhere.

items.title: Guided picking
items.body: Pick lists, locations and quantities shown in view; confirmation by glance, voice or RFID read.

items.title: Packing and verification
items.body: Order contents verified against the pick as items are packed.

items.title: RFID-enabled tracking
items.body: Items and locations read automatically; no line-of-sight scanning.

items.title: Real-time backend updates
items.body: WMS and ERP updated as each pick, pack and move completes.

items.title: Inventory visibility
items.body: Live stock positions and exceptions on dashboards for supervisors.

items.title: Training and onboarding
items.body: New pickers productive in hours with in-view guidance.
